description: Multi-City Trips - Allow users to plan trips with 2-4 city legs, with inter-city transport links between them. Each leg reuses existing planner logic.
steps: 1. Add MultiCityLeg and MultiCityTrip interfaces to src/utils/plannerLogic.ts. MultiCityLeg includes: legNumber, destination, days, startDate, endDate, itinerary (GeneratedItinerary), and optional transportToNext (mode, durationHours, costInr). MultiCityTrip includes: id, legs[], totalDays, totalCostInr, createdAt.

2. Implement calculateInterCityTransport(from, to, mode) helper in plannerLogic.ts that uses haversine distance between destinations and calculates duration (flight: 600km/h, train: 80km/h, bus: 60km/h) and cost (flight: ₹8/km, train: ₹1.5/km, bus: ₹1/km).

3. Implement generateMultiCityTrip(legs, baseInput) async function in plannerLogic.ts that: iterates through legs, calls generateTripPlan for each with correct dates, calculates transport between consecutive legs, accumulates total cost, returns MultiCityTrip object.

4. Create src/components/MultiCityPlanner.tsx with: array of leg inputs (destination dropdown, days input), Add City button (max 4 legs), Remove button (min 2 legs), Generate Multi-City Trip button. Share base inputs (start city, budget, mood, group, energy) across all legs.

5. Create src/components/MultiCityItinerary.tsx that renders: trip summary header (X cities, Y days, ₹Z total), numbered leg cards (each showing destination name, date range, full itinerary with ActivitiesItinerary component), transport connection cards between legs (mode icon, duration, cost), total cost summary footer.
6. Add /multi-city route to src/App.tsx that renders MultiCityPlanner.
7. Add 'Plan Multi-City Trip' navigation link in Header or home page.
8. Add multi-city trip support to savedTripsService: save multi-city trips with flag is_multi_city=true in trip_data, display them in saved trips list with 'Multi-City' badge.

9. Add unit tests in src/utils/plannerLogic.test.ts covering: generateMultiCityTrip with 2 legs returns correct structure, total cost includes all leg costs plus transport costs, dates are continuous across legs, transport calculation produces reasonable duration and cost.
acceptance_criteria: User can add 2-4 city legs to multi-city planner
Each leg has independent destination and duration (1-7 days)
Generate button creates itinerary for each leg using existing plannerLogic
Inter-city transport automatically calculated with mode, duration, and cost
Timeline shows continuous dates across all legs (leg 2 starts day after leg 1 ends + travel day)
Total cost includes all leg costs plus inter-city transport costs
UI displays numbered legs with travel connection cards showing transport details
Multi-city trips can be saved to database and loaded later
Unit tests pass for multi-city generation (npm run test)
verification: npm run lint - TypeScript strict mode passes
npm run test - all tests pass including multi-city plannerLogic tests
Manual: Navigate to /multi-city, verify form with 2 initial leg inputs
Manual: Add 3rd and 4th legs, verify Add button disables at 4 legs
Manual: Select destinations (Goa 3 days, Jaipur 2 days, Ladakh 4 days), click Generate
Manual: Verify itinerary shows 3 numbered sections with full day plans
Manual: Verify transport cards between legs show mode/duration/cost (e.g., ✈️ Flight to Jaipur, 2h, ₹4,800)
Manual: Verify total cost at bottom includes all legs + transport
Manual: Save multi-city trip, verify it appears in saved trips with 'Multi-City' badge
Manual: Verify dates are continuous (if leg 1 is Dec 1-3, transport Dec 4, leg 2 starts Dec 5)
